description.zh: 用行与列精确对齐数据的二维表格：一行一条记录、一列一个字段，适合逐列比较、排序与大容量数据浏览。 行可悬停高亮、点击选中，列头通常带排序控制。
description.en: A two-dimensional grid aligning data in rows and columns — one record per row, one field per column — built for column-by-column comparison, sorting and high-volume browsing. Rows highlight on hover and support selection; column headers usually carry sort controls.

use_when.zh: 字段多、需要逐列比较的数据
后台管理列表（订单、用户、日志）
需要排序、筛选、批量操作的密集数据
use_when.en: Dense data with sorting, filtering and batch actions

avoid_when.zh: 移动端窄屏放不下列（转为卡片列表）
avoid_when.en: Narrow mobile screens cannot fit columns — switch to card lists

avoid_when.zh: 内容以浏览为主、比较为辅（用 card 流）
avoid_when.en: Browsing-oriented content — use a card feed

avoid_when.zh: 每条记录字段很少且强调视觉（用卡片或列表）
avoid_when.en: Few fields with visual emphasis — use cards or lists

note.zh: 隔行底色，长表格更易读
note.en: Alternating row tint eases long scans

适合内容.zh: 结构化记录、财务与日志

notes.zh: 容器 overflow-x-auto 处理窄屏；数字列右对齐、文本列左对齐；斑马纹用 odd 行底色。 排序：th 内放按钮并标记 aria-sort，二次点击反向。固定表头用 sticky top-0 配表头底色。 行密度用 py 控制紧凑（约 8px）或舒适（约 16px）。
notes.en: Wrap in overflow-x-auto for narrow screens; right-align numbers, left-align text; stripe with an odd-row tint. Sorting: a button inside th with aria-sort, second click reverses. Sticky header via sticky top-0 over a header background. Control density with row padding (~8px compact vs ~16px comfortable).

basic.zh: 创建一个表格（Table）组件：展示订单列表，包含列头排序、行悬停高亮与状态列。
basic.en: Create a Table component: an order list with sortable column headers, row hover highlight and a status column.

design.zh: 创建数据表格。要求：细线分隔行（或斑马纹），表头小写灰字加粗、可点击排序（带方向指示）； 数字列右对齐且用等宽数字；行悬停浅色高亮；状态列用彩色圆点 + 文字；行高紧凑舒适两档。
design.en: Create a data table. Requirements: hairline row separators (or stripes), bold small grey headers that click to sort (with direction indicator), right-aligned numeric columns with tabular figures, light row hover, a status column with coloured dot + text, compact and comfortable row densities.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Table：数据数组 + sortKey/sortDir 受控，useMemo 排序； thead th 内 button 触发排序并设 aria-sort="ascending/descending"； 数字列 className text-right tabular-nums；容器 overflow-x-auto； 斑马纹 odd:bg-code-bg；行选中用 state + aria-selected； 排序动画时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Table: data array with controlled sortKey/sortDir, sorting via useMemo; a button inside thead th triggers sorting and sets aria-sort="ascending/descending"; numeric columns get text-right tabular-nums; container overflow-x-auto; stripes with odd:bg-code-bg; row selection with state + aria-selected; animation durations scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1).

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现数据表格（Table）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的表面色与文本层级变量。
用途：后台订单/成员列表。
要求：
- 列头点击排序（aria-sort），支持升序/降序切换
- 数字列右对齐，文本列左对齐
- 行悬停高亮，支持斑马纹变体
- 窄屏 overflow-x 处理，深浅色主题一致
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a data Table component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
surface and text hierarchy variables.
Usage: admin order/member lists.
Requirements:
- Click-to-sort headers (aria-sort) with ascending/descending toggle
- Right-aligned numeric columns, left-aligned text columns
- Row hover highlight and a striped variant
- overflow-x handling on narrow screens; consistent light/dark themes
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 尝试排序、选择行与操作，比较表头和内容的对齐。
task.en: Try sorting, selection and row actions; inspect header alignment.

checks.zh: 数值对齐方便比较，排序方向有明确提示。
checks.en: Align comparable numbers and indicate sort direction.

checks.zh: 窄屏可横向查看表格，但页面本身不应溢出。
checks.en: Allow local table scrolling without overflowing the page.
